name: butter-language
description: Syntax highlighting and language server support (diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion) for the Butter programming language (.butter)

butter.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `butter-lsp` executable. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`. Leave empty to use the server bundled with this extension, falling back to `PATH` (`butter-lsp` / `butter-lsp.exe`) if no bundled binary is present — see [Language Server](https://github.com/abrahampost/Butter#language-server) for how to build/install one yourself.

scripts.package:win32-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js win32-x64 && vsce package --target win32-x64
scripts.package:linux-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js linux-x64 && vsce package --target linux-x64
scripts.package:linux-arm64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js linux-arm64 && vsce package --target linux-arm64
scripts.package:darwin-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js darwin-x64 && vsce package --target darwin-x64
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js darwin-arm64 && vsce package --target darwin-arm64
scripts.package:all: npm run package:win32-x64 && npm run package:linux-x64 && npm run package:linux-arm64 && npm run package:darwin-x64 && npm run package:darwin-arm64
scripts.publish:win32-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js win32-x64 && vsce publish --target win32-x64
scripts.publish:linux-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js linux-x64 && vsce publish --target linux-x64
scripts.publish:linux-arm64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js linux-arm64 && vsce publish --target linux-arm64
scripts.publish:darwin-x64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js darwin-x64 && vsce publish --target darwin-x64
scripts.publish:darwin-arm64: node scripts/stage-lsp-binary.js darwin-arm64 && vsce publish --target darwin-arm64
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:win32-x64 && npm run publish:linux-x64 && npm run publish:linux-arm64 && npm run publish:darwin-x64 && npm run publish:darwin-arm64
